programmes.d: A crafty rancher tries to frame his wife with a hired hand in a plot to force money from her father.
An itinerant trail hand attempts to leave Dodge City with the fiance of the man who befriended him.
Chester finds himself the unwilling guardian and nurse of a runaway Indian who has been befriended by a young white girl.
After white men slay his father, half-breed Quint Asper joins the Comanche tribe of his Indian mother so he can avenge the killing. (TV-PG)
After eight years in prison, embittered Collie Patten is unable to adjust to the changes he finds when he returns home.
An untamed nature girl develops a liking for Marshal Matt Dillon and isn't shy about expressing it.
A cowhand accused of murder assists Marshal Dillon when the latter's eyesight is impaired in an attack by three desperadoes. (TV-PG)
Quint Asper, framed as a horse thief by two bad men, angrily leaves town after being beaten up by several Dodge City residents. (TV-PG)

An aspiring but naive bounty hunter seeks to bring outlaws to justice in late 1800's Texas. His plans unravel when he finds himself at the right place at the right time to rescue a beautiful young woman from a drunken mob.
A notorious gunman returns to Dodge City after five years in prison and is unable to convince anyone he has reformed.
A spinster’s misdirected concern for her younger sister leads to misunderstanding and ultimately to tragedy.
Quint Asper becomes the unwilling object of a girl’s affections when her harried parents travel through Dodge City.
Matt Dillon pursues a murderer-bank robber into Mexico only to end up with his prisoner in a Mexican jail.
Matt Dillon and his prisoner, Charlie Hacker, get released from a Mexican jail, but meet a gang of bandits while riding toward Texas.
An itinerant medicine man and his daughter find only tragedy when they attempt to sell their wares in Dodge City.
An eccentric transient and his motley offspring bring tragedy to a peace-loving rancher and his family.
Matt Dillon comes to the aid of an innocent wolf hunter who discovers that a local rancher is butchering cattle illegally.
The life of a small girl is endangered because she is the only witness to the shooting of her mother.
Two Indian-style murders on a Dodge City street threaten to start a full-scale panic among the jittery townspeople.
The ambitious wife of a new doctor tries to steal patients away from Doc Adams by spreading rumors that old Doc is an alcoholic.
The father of a rag-tag family of seven offers to sell his teenaged daughter to Marshal Dillon as a wife.
Festus Haggen’s hillbilly nephew, Eliab, comes to Dodge City to settle a score with Festus.
An old friend of Kitty's travels West for the sole purpose of aiding her fugitive son's wife in childbirth.
